discovery_notes: 30 WebSearch calls (standard), all search_snippet; blocked marketplaces/pin DBs excluded. Sources mainly WDWNT and Disney Pins Blog, plus Laughing Place, MickeyBlog, Disney Mouseketeer, DisMerchandise. Conflicts kept: World Showcase food pins WDWNT 2026-06-30 vs DPB July 2026; Norway School Bread 17.99 (WDWNT) vs 14.99 (DPB); 55th mystery set 7 vs 8 designs. Possible duplicates kept separate: R2-D2 (WDWNT) vs R2-D2 'Beep Boop!' (DPB). GotG Other World Showcase OE/price attributed to DPB Jan wk2 with moderate confidence. Edition not stated for MK 'M' pin, AK logo/silhouette pins (a DPB snippet of unclear attribution called similar 'Tropical Mickey' pins OE), and Morocco Mickey. Skipped: 55th castle glitter pin (21.99, LR per sources), AK mystery sets (date/edition unclear), DPB Boba Fett/Stormtrooper/Ewok OE (location unclear), Mickey & Minnie 'My happy place'/Pink Heart (Disney Parks generic, may overlap couple pins), disneybymark.com (mirrors WDWNT), retailer listings. | Key fix 2026-10-16: 45 single-pin set keys renamed from <pin_key> to .../oe-single/<slug> (set key must differ from pin key).
